title: EasyEffects-compatible preset
description: A pipeline preset as written by EasyEffects 8.3.2 and by Resonance. Exactly one of input/output must be present. Instance objects are intentionally open: unknown keys are preserved.

plugins_order.description: Instance ids in signal order, e.g. equalizer#0.

^[a-z_]+(#\\d+)?$.description: Plugin instance settings. Keys are kebab-case EasyEffects settings; unknown keys are preserved.
